Card Q&A.a: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when that Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area" mean, exactly?

Effect: [On Play] By trashing 1 [Morphomon] or [Eosmon] in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞.
[All Turns] While you have [Eosmon], none of your opponent's Tamers' [On Play] effects activate.
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your [Eosmon] would leave the battle area by an opponent's effect, by deleting 1 of your other [Eosmon], prevent it from leaving.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
